The people behind the business

Trust has a place
in every connection.

Company identities and representative roles help people know who they're speaking with. Ownership information and formal certifications need clear, separate labels.

Company identity

Permanent business profiles managed by authorized representatives. Claiming and verifying a business is part of the planned onboarding.

Business communities

Veteran-owned, woman-owned, and small businesses belong within the wider BOND network.

Clear credentials

Self-reported ownership is different from verified certification. VOSB and SDVOSB designations will require their own verification process.

What comes next

Built to keep
connections growing.

Company and event hubs first. More ways to discover the right people as BOND grows.

The longer-term direction includes Chamber communities, AI-assisted business matching, and a CardBrief connection to carry introductions from the expo into your network.
